{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-la-e","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"356f2df0950a5c11aca76cda7845f98bc7d0136d8f936eb00d3009d95cdcfeb6","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-la-class-std:lineage:1","source_registry_sha256":"8fb2294cb50570a3a0fabb25acba3418dba999eb7dd305cc58b73fdf38975613","source_liveness_sha256":"1105a92b5841d065519de4b7fbea05111880de6d2bb8804066a972d19c63b5a0"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C","chunk_id":"C.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Class E licensing and identity documents","heading":"Class E licensing and identity documents","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"# Class E licensing and identity documents

FACT_ID: sec01-F01 | anchor: A01
A Louisiana resident who drives on the state’s public streets or highways needs a Louisiana driver license. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-F02 | anchor: A01
Keep your driver license with you whenever you drive. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-F03 | anchor: A01
When an officer asks to inspect your driver license, you must show it. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-F04 | anchor: A01
A new Louisiana resident has 30 days after establishing residency to obtain a Louisiana license. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-F05 | anchor: A01
A nonresident with a valid license from another state may drive in Louisiana for 90 days without obtaining a Louisiana license. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-F06 | anchor: A01
A nonresident student is exempt from obtaining a Louisiana license when carrying both a valid home-state license and a current student identification card. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-F07 | anchor: A01
Temporarily operating a farm tractor, farm implement or road machinery on a highway does not require obtaining a Louisiana driver license. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-F08 | anchor: A01
An Armed Forces member operating a United States government vehicle on official duty does not need a Louisiana license for that operation. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-F09 | anchor: A01
Resident service members and their resident military dependents are exempt from obtaining a Louisiana license while holding a valid license from their home state. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-F10 | anchor: A01
The license class you need depends on the vehicle you will operate and whether driving is the main purpose of your employment. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-F11 | anchor: A02
Class E covers a single motor vehicle weighing under 10,001 pounds, recreational vehicles, and qualifying farm vehicles outside the commercial-vehicle definition. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F12 | anchor: A02
A Temporary Instruction Permit is limited to a student’s use while enrolled in driver education or a pre-licensing course. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F13 | anchor: A02
Louisiana licenses and identification cards must use the applicant’s complete legal name. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F14 | anchor: A02
Identity papers must be originals or copies certified by the department that keeps the record. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F15 | anchor: A02
A photocopy is not acceptable identification even when a notary has certified it. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F16 | anchor: A02
The first-time applicant document list permits one primary document with two secondary documents, or two primary documents. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F17 | anchor: A03
Additional identification is unnecessary when a Louisiana identification card clearly identifies the applicant by photograph and the file already contains the Social Security number. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F18 | anchor: A03
For an applicant aged seventeen or younger, a custodial parent or legal guardian must sign for license issuance, duplicate issuance and restriction changes. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F19 | anchor: A03
Both the minor applicant and the parent or guardian must present identification. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F20 | anchor: A03
When parents have joint custody, only the domiciliary parent may sign the minor’s application. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F21 | anchor: A03
The minor’s licensing application also requires the custody documents. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F22 | anchor: A03
Louisiana does not allow a person to hold more than one driver license. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F23 | anchor: A03
An applicant eligible for a Social Security number must provide the assigned number when applying for a license. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F24 | anchor: A03
The Social Security number goes into the licensing department’s internal file rather than onto the license face. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F25 | anchor: A03
An applicant without an assigned Social Security number must obtain an official Social Security Administration letter stating that none was assigned or that the applicant is ineligible. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F26 | anchor: A03
The guide requires male United States citizens or immigrants aged 15 through 26 to provide their Social Security number for a license or identification card, and says refusal prevents issuance. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F27 | anchor: A03
First-license applicants must finish the required driver education and show proof before applying for the license. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F28 | anchor: A03
A Temporary Instruction Permit must be obtained before a knowledge test, a skills test or any behind-the-wheel instruction. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F29 | anchor: A04
A Class E learner-permit applicant must be at least fifteen and complete every applicable graduated-licensing stage. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]
